title: Sarvam 2B Introduction
summary: Sarvam AI introduced Sarvam 2B on August 13, 2024 as an open-source small Indic language model trained from scratch on an internal four-trillion-token dataset and designed for ten Indian languages plus English.
significance: A documented public introduction of an India-developed multilingual language model explicitly built for Indic-language coverage.

geography.note: Sarvam AI's first-party launch announcement is datelined Bangalore, India, on August 13, 2024. This field records the announcement location only and does not infer model-training or organizational geography beyond the sourced statement.

verification.note: Sarvam AI's first-party launch post is dated August 13, 2024 and states that the company introduced Sarvam 2B that day, describing it as an open-source 2B small Indic language model trained from scratch on an internal dataset of four trillion tokens with efficient representation for ten Indian languages. A surviving model-card copy independently preserves the model description and an August 15, 2024 usage-update note, but is used only as corroboration. Marketing superlatives such as 'first' are not adopted as LINEAiGE factual claims. No ancestry, influence, causality or relationships are inferred.
